_comment: OpenPantry iOS Shortcut / NFC tag URL templates. Replace SCRIPT_ID with your deployed Apps Script ID.

ios_shortcuts.name: Feed Bread Pitt
ios_shortcuts.trigger: NFC tag on jar lid OR home screen widget
ios_shortcuts.tip: Add to home screen. Tap once, see 🍞 confirmation. Done.

ios_shortcuts.name: Water Rosie
ios_shortcuts.trigger: NFC tag on pot OR home screen widget
ios_shortcuts.tip: Tap when you water. Keeps streak alive without any typing.

ios_shortcuts.name: Harvest Rosie (ask amount)
steps: Action: Ask for Input → 'Grams harvested?' (Number, default 5)
ios_shortcuts.tip: One extra tap to enter grams. All other shortcuts are truly one-tap.

script_properties._comment: Set these in Apps Script → Project Settings → Script Properties

deploy_steps: 1. Open script.google.com → New Project → paste log_entry.gs
2. Project Settings → Script Properties → add the four keys above
3. Deploy → New Deployment → Web App → Execute as Me → Anyone can access
4. Copy the /exec URL and replace SCRIPT_ID in this file and in NFC tags
5. iOS: Open Shortcuts app → New Shortcut → Add Action: URL + Open URLs
6. iOS: Automation tab → New Automation → NFC → scan tag → run shortcut
7. Stick NTAG213 stickers (Amazon, ~$10 for 50) on jar lids and pots
8. Write URLs to tags using NFC Tools app (free, iOS/Android)
